Nothing was run in this session.

criteria_notes.note: test_apply_conditions_not_modified checks 304 on GET/HEAD with entity headers removed via run_wsgi_app; test_apply_conditions_if_none_match_other_methods checks 412 on other methods.
test_apply_conditions_no_headers and test_apply_conditions_not_modified assert Accept-Ranges: bytes.
test_apply_range_basic and test_apply_range_clamp_and_first_only check 206, data, Content-Length, Content-Range, clamping, first range only.

test_apply_range_unsatisfiable (416), test_apply_range_ignored (non-bytes/invalid), test_apply_range_if_range (IfRange.check mismatch leaves 200), test_apply_range_skipped_when_not_200, test_apply_range_skipped_for_other_methods.
